title: Almost P15M worth of marijuana bricks seized in Ifugao buy-bust

blocks.text: SANTIAGO CITY, ISABELA, Philippines — Police seized some P14.64 million worth of marijuana bricks placed inside sacks from a “high-value” drug suspect in a buy-bust operation in Banaue, Ifugao, on Tuesday, Nov. 17, the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) said. According to PDEA, the arrested 42-year-old suspect from Rizal, Kalinga yielded four sacks loaded with 122 kilos of dried marijuana with fruiting tops. One of the sacks with 31 kilos of marijuana worth P3.7 million was the subject of the buy-bust operation.
